architecture: MobileNetV2 + SE trunk, multiplicatively gated by a 1x1-conv Dice-supervised localisation head
description: Fine-tuned on the cleaned 60k ISIC-archive pool (binary labels) with auxiliary Dice supervision from the 900 expert lesion outlines (lambda=1.0). SE attention on the final 1280x7x7 map (reduction 16), gate = sigmoid(loc_head(F_att)) multiplying the feature map before pooling: F_pooled = AvgPool(F_att * A7), A28 = sigmoid(upsample(loc_head(F_att), 28)).
source_study: Melanoma ablation study (ABLATION_STUDY) - final 30-epoch gated grid

config.dds_note: DDS=0: this model reads the TRAINING-EXACT preprocessed image, not a DDPM-purified copy. gating_service.py preprocessing is already the training-exact recipe.

why_this_model: The study's best COMPLETE model (verdict + lesion map). It is the only gated fine-tuned CNN that satisfies both deployed requirements at once: classification AUC essentially tied with the grid best, and a gate that clears the 0.65 IoU localisation bar. CBAM FT+Gate has the top AUC (0.9743) but FAILS the IoU bar (0.5943); MobileNetV2 FT+Gate clears it (0.6622) but with lower AUC; SE FT+Gate clears it (0.6804) AND ties on AUC.
params_note: state_dict tensors sum to 2,466,679 because they include BatchNorm running stats and num_batches_tracked (buffers, not parameters)

metrics_60k_test_split.caveat: the 60k pool overlaps the public ISIC 376-image benchmark test set (89.6% exact pHash duplicates) and 319 near-duplicates (pHash d=2-4) were kept, so these numbers are inflated relative to an external benchmark.

metrics_900_test_localisation.note: gate map is the model's Dice-supervised localisation artifact; Grad-CAM is the post-hoc baseline. A mask-supervised map is not interchangeable with a post-hoc explanation - report which one a claim refers to.

input.preprocessing: DullRazor hair removal (NO morphological OPEN), Shades-of-Grey power=6, aspect-preserving resize to 224 + zero pad

verification.exported: bare state_dict (optimizer/scheduler/scaler stripped); loads under the backend's torch 2.1.2+cpu / numpy 1.26.4
verification.note: the source .pth is a full training checkpoint; this artifact is the bare state_dict, matching the convention of the other files in models/
